command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp MPLBACKEND=Agg
cd /tmp

# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
# No PATH export: aarchsci env images already have their python first.
# MPLBACKEND=Agg because nilearn/dipy import matplotlib and there is no display.

echo "== staged bytes must match their pins =="
sha256sum -c pins.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: identities.py does not match its pin"; exit 1; }

echo "== the AFNI programs this recipe uses must be present =="
# The conda AFNI package ships a SUBSET of AFNI's programs: 3dDWItoDT and the rest of the
# diffusion toolbox are absent from this build, which is why the cross-check here is about
# reading NIfTI rather than fitting tensors. Check what is used, before using it.
for t in afni 3dinfo 3dcalc 3dTstat; do
  command -v "$t" >/dev/null || { echo "FAIL: $t absent from this image"; exit 1; }
  printf '  %-10s %s\n' "$t" "$(command -v $t)"
done
printf '  %-10s %s\n' 3dDWItoDT "$(command -v 3dDWItoDT || echo 'absent (expected -- see the page)')"

# python3 -u so a killed run still has its output in command.log.
python3 -u identities.py 2>&1 | tee identities.log
RC="${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
cp score.tsv neuroimaging-diag.txt 2>/dev/null
test "$RC" = "0" || { echo "FAIL: an identity failed"; exit 1; }

uname -m | awk '{print "arch\t"$1}'
echo "DONE"
